parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US (default): English.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token must be unique for each request and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the health check template.
